subsystems.title: Chassis & structure
subsystems.subtitle: Frame design and structural response
subsystems.design: The frame links the driver cell, seat supports and perimeter rails into a single load path. The design report specifies AISI 4130 steel for the frame tubes.
subsystems.approach: Finite-element studies cover front, rear and side impact cases, followed by a torsional stiffness case. Result values and pass claims are held because the source report conflicts with its own interpretation.

calculation.label: Structural check
calculation.note: Nominal stress relation; impact loads and numerical results remain under review.

ergonomics.title: Posture & ergonomics · CATIA
ergonomics.description: Side and front occupant views support a qualitative review of seated posture, seat support, steering and pedal reach, and cockpit clearance. This visual fit check does not claim measured anthropometric dimensions or ergonomic certification.

subsystems.title: Steering & front end
subsystems.subtitle: Wheel guidance and front-corner components
subsystems.design: The steering layout uses Ackermann geometry to coordinate the inside and outside front wheels. The knuckle and stub arm support wheel alignment and transmit front-corner loads.
subsystems.approach: ANSYS static-structural cases are reported for the knuckle and stub arm. Steering radii and component result values are not published because the source assumptions and interpretations need reconciliation.

calculation.label: Ackermann relation
calculation.note: Relates inner and outer wheel angles to track and wheelbase; geometry outputs remain under review.

subsystems.title: Braking system
subsystems.subtitle: Hydraulic actuation and thermal response
subsystems.design: Pedal force is transmitted through the hydraulic circuit to the master cylinder, caliper and brake disc. The master-cylinder mount is included as a structural support component.
subsystems.approach: The source includes a transient thermal study of the disc and a static-structural study of the master-cylinder mount. Braking assumptions differ between reports, so no performance or thermal result is presented as validated.

calculation.label: Energy to be dissipated
calculation.note: Braking energy relation; source mass and speed assumptions are not reconciled.

subsystems.title: Electric drivetrain
subsystems.subtitle: Motor, chain reduction and rear axle
subsystems.design: The motor drives the rear axle through a chain reduction. The tripod joint transfers torque, while the motor and shaft mounts support the rotating assembly.
subsystems.approach: The CAE report analyses the rear shaft, tripod, motor mounts and shaft mount. Torque assumptions and some interpretations conflict, so simulation values are withheld.
